note: Each pilot gate requires a passing stable release gate PLUS the requirements below. None of these is satisfied. A passing Phase 7 source gate contributes nothing here: source completeness was never evidence that a device may be manufactured, a fleet deployed, or a hosted service launched.

notes.qualifiedHardwareModel: operations/data/hardware-evidence.json contains no reports. No physical machine exists.
notes.oemRecoveryValidation: No OEM recovery media has been built or booted on physical hardware.
notes.signedOemProfile: No key exists in the oem- namespace, of either class. See operations/data/signing-keys.json.
notes.factoryFinalisationOnHardware: bunny-oem inspect settles 17 of 22 checks by inspection; 5 require signed live attestation from a real device. No device exists.
notes.brandingAndLicensingApproval: The licence is decided and the licence gate passes, but docs/TRADEMARK_POLICY_DRAFT.md is a draft and reviews/legal/ has not been commissioned. OEM distribution needs both.
notes.namedSupportOwner: SUSTAINABILITY_REPORT.md records one maintainer and no funded support rota.

notes.fleetControlPlaneImplemented: ADR-023 places bunny-fleet-server, bunny-enrolment-service and bunny-enterprise-console in separate repositories. None exists. The device-side agent is implemented; the control plane it talks to is not.
notes.tenantIsolationPenetrationTest: tests/multitenancy/ passes 23 source tests written by the same author as the code. That is not a penetration test.
notes.consoleRoleTesting: The seven roles are modelled and unit-tested. No console exists to exercise them against.
notes.supportCapacity: One maintainer. The Phase 7 surface exceeds that capacity, as PHASE_7_REPORT.md already records.

notes.independentCryptographicReview: reviews/cryptography/ is prepared and not commissioned. This is the single hardest requirement in the list: it needs an identified cryptographer and money.
notes.operatedSyncService: No sync service has been operated. The client is implemented; there is no server.
notes.keyRecoveryDrill: The four recovery methods are unit-tested. No drill has been run against an operated service.
notes.deletionDrill: The six deletion scopes have disclosed retention bounds. No drill has verified an operator can meet them.
notes.servicePrivacyReview: ENCRYPTED_SYNC_PRIVACY_REVIEW.md reviews the design. A service privacy review requires a service.
notes.dataResidencyDisclosure: No residency can be disclosed because no data is stored anywhere.
